core: Amino acid and peptide transmembrane transport
qualifier: neutral amino acids and proton-coupled oligopeptides
name: Neutral amino acid and proton-coupled peptide transport
rationale: Members are SLC carriers moving neutral amino acids (glycine, proline, tryptophan, histidine) and di/oligopeptides, incl. Hartnup and iminoglycinuria defects; unlike confusables they lack cystine/urate/organic anion carriers and branched-chain/aromatic leucine-type uptake but add proton-coupled peptide cotransport.

name: HIV entry, uncoating and reverse transcription
rationale: All four members are the early HIV-1 steps from virion binding to minus- and plus-strand DNA synthesis, distinct from integration, Nef/Vpu host-protein downregulation and APOBEC3G restriction confusables.

name: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern phagocyte oxidative burst, superoxide generation, degranulation and killing of bacteria and fungi, whereas confusables centre on neutrophil chemotaxis, formyl peptide receptors and complement signalling.

qualifier: protein targeting to centrosome and cell cortex
name: Centrosome positioning and protein targeting to centrosome or cortex
rationale: All members concern establishing and maintaining centrosome location and localizing proteins to the centrosome or cortex, without the mitotic, spindle-orientation or meiotic content of the confusables.

qualifier: adiponectin; glucose and fatty acid uptake
name: Insulin- and adiponectin-regulated glucose and fatty acid uptake
rationale: Members cover GLUT4 translocation, insulin-stimulated glucose import, insulin receptor recycling/catabolism, adiponectin signalling and restraint of fatty acid uptake and oxidation, unlike confusables about beta-cell insulin secretion, lipolysis or glucagon signalling.

name: Glycolysis-to-lactate flux control by p53 and mTORC1
rationale: Members regulate glycolysis, pentose-phosphate shunt and nucleotide catabolism with lactate production, together with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic programmes, distinguishing them from the TCA/NADPH, FOXO, fructose-bisphosphate and hypoxia/HIF confusables.

name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate pathway interconversions
rationale: All members are the non-oxidative PPP sugar-phosphate interconversions (ribose-5-P isomerase, transaldolase, xylulose-5-P) and their deficiencies, not the glucuronate/pentosuria, fructose, galactose or alditol pathways of the confusables.

name: Gut and urinary tract smooth muscle motility
rationale: Members concern peristalsis, gastric motility, intestinal and urinary tract smooth muscle contraction and micturition plus stomach function, unlike confusables on enteric nervous system development, general smooth muscle relaxation or reproductive smooth muscle.

name: Regulation of cilium assembly and disassembly
rationale: All three members control ciliogenesis versus cilium resorption, distinct from intraflagellar transport and centrosome/microtubule nucleation confusables.

qualifier: elongation, peroxisomal beta-oxidation and ether lipids
name: Very-long-chain fatty acid elongation, peroxisomal oxidation and ether lipids
rationale: Members span VLCFA elongation and acyl-CoA synthesis, peroxisomal acyl-CoA oxidase beta-oxidation (incl. ALD, pristanoyl-CoA), PUFA metabolism and plasmalogen/wax synthesis, while confusables add peroxisome biogenesis, sterol synthesis or alpha/omega-oxidation.

qualifier: downstream of oncogenic RAS and RAF1 mutants
name: MEK-ERK activation downstream of oncogenic RAS and RAF1
rationale: All three members describe MAP2K/MAPK activation driven by RAS or RAF1 mutants, unlike confusables on integrin-Rap1 signalling or MRAS/SHOC2 RAF activation and Ras regulation.

core: Rho GTPase control in axon guidance
qualifier: RAC1/CDC42 downstream of ROBO, DCC and ephrin receptors
name: RAC1/CDC42 regulation by ROBO, DCC and ephrin receptors
rationale: Members are guidance-receptor signalling steps that activate or inactivate RAC1/CDC42 (ROBO-SLIT, DCC netrin attraction, ephrin), distinct from confusables on RHOA, commissural pathfinding, L1 and netrin repulsion.

name: NMDA receptor activation and long-term potentiation signaling
rationale: Members cover NMDA receptor assembly, unblocking and glutamate activation, downstream Ras/RAC1 signalling and LTP, unlike confusables about postsynaptic structural plasticity, dendrites and BDNF/TrkB.

qualifier: priming, polymerase switching and Okazaki processing
name: DNA replication priming, elongation and Okazaki fragment processing
rationale: Members are core replication fork steps (initiation, primer synthesis, pol switching, flap removal, strand elongation), distinct from translesion synthesis, base/nucleotide excision repair gap filling and cell-cycle replication-control confusables.

name: Platelet GPCR signaling by ADP, thrombin and prostanoids
rationale: Members are platelet G protein-coupled agonist pathways (P2Y1/P2Y12, PARs, TP and prostacyclin receptors) and platelet activation, distinct from confusables on GPVI/collagen, adhesion, degranulation and coagulation.

name: Ventricular trabecula formation and cardiomyocyte development
rationale: All members concern ventricular trabecular myocardium morphogenesis and cardiomyocyte proliferation/development, unlike confusables on endocardium, second heart field, compact myocardium or early heart tube.

qualifier: insulin and glucagon secretion and action
name: Insulin and glucagon secretion and action in glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members span beta-cell insulin secretion (KATP, GLP-1/GIP, FFAR1), insulin receptor signalling and GLUT4, glucagon/PKA signalling and glycogen and glucokinase control, while confusables focus on adipocyte lipid handling, gluconeogenic transcription or peripheral uptake only.

name: Purine nucleoside catabolism via ADA and PNP
rationale: Members degrade AMP/IMP and adenosine/inosine/deoxynucleosides through ADA and PNP toward allantoin, distinct from purine salvage (PRPP, HPRT, APRT) and deoxyribonucleotide/pyrimidine catabolism confusables.

qualifier: SMO-GLI with proteasomal turnover of signalling regulators
name: Smoothened-GLI Hedgehog transduction and proteasomal regulator turnover
rationale: Members centre on SMO activation and GLI processing/degradation plus proteasome-mediated turnover of DVL, NOTCH4 and SLIT/ROBO regulators and nuclear receptor signalling modulation, whereas confusables cover Hh ligand lipidation/release, Notch activation or Wnt planar polarity.

name: Colony-stimulating factor control of macrophage and osteoclast development
rationale: Members cover M-CSF/CSF1 and GM-/G-CSF signalling and production, monocyte/macrophage/dendritic differentiation, osteoclast differentiation and fusion and bone resorption, distinct from granulopoiesis, macrophage fusion/DAP12 and SIRP confusables.

qualifier: SOS-driven, with RSK and p38 outputs
name: SOS-mediated RAS activation and downstream MAPK effector signaling
rationale: Members describe positive RAS signalling via SOS/SHC, RAS and MAP2K mutants and RSK/p38 outputs, unlike confusables dominated by RAS GAPs, ERK inactivation and negative feedback.

name: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase variants and kinase-inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are cancer mutants, fusions or amplifications of KIT, PDGFR, FLT3, ERBB2/EGFR, FGFR, ALK/LTK and their TKI binding or resistance, distinct from confusables on wild-type RTK, cytokine receptor and downstream RAS/PI3K signalling.

qualifier: cytochrome P450 oxidation and sulfonation; steroids
name: Xenobiotic and steroid biotransformation by P450 oxidation and sulfonation
rationale: Members cover phase I oxidative (CYP-mediated demethylation, hydroxylation) and sulfonation metabolism of xenobiotics, toxins, terpenoids and steroids, whereas confusables emphasise acetylation, methylation, FMO or specific drugs/mycotoxins.

name: Gonadotropin secretion regulation and ovarian follicle development
rationale: Members regulate FSH and LH secretion and ovarian follicle development, distinct from confusables on ovulation/luteal events, Sertoli/testis development and activin-follistatin signalling.

name: Microglial activation and amyloid-beta formation and clearance
rationale: Members concern microglial differentiation, activation and cytotoxicity together with APP/amyloid-beta production, fibril formation and clearance and tau tangles, while confusables centre on apoptotic cell engulfment, DAP12 or oxidised-LDL signalling.
